name: M&J Frank Inc.
old_description: M&J Frank has been selling quality restaurant supplies since 1939. We are a third generation business that has throughout the years maintained an extremely high level of service. From the tabletop to the bar, from the kitchen to the washroom, M&J can help solve all of your needs . For over 80 years in New Jersey, we have served the public and the food service industry with courteous, friendly service and the finest restaurant equipment brand names available.  Our loyal customers have not only enjoyed our vast selection of foodservice essentials, but they've also experienced the difference that quality and service can make. We’re dedicated to helping you in your culinary endeavors and are excited to be a part of your success story.
about:
M&J Frank Inc. has operated from East Hanover, New Jersey, since its founding in 1939. The company remains a third-generation family business, continuing a legacy of supplying restaurant equipment and supplies to the region's food-service community. The current ownership traces back to the original founders, though individual names are not publicly disclosed.

The firm stocks and sells a broad range of products for commercial kitchens and dining rooms, including disposable items, janitorial supplies, smallwares, and major equipment lines from established manufacturers. A physical showroom at 29 Eagle Rock Avenue allows customers to inspect items before purchase, and printed catalogs support remote ordering for items ranging from tabletop accessories to heavy-duty cooking equipment.

Customers span the food-service spectrum: independent restaurants, institutional cafeterias, catering operations, and home cooks. The company emphasizes service to chefs and restaurant owners throughout New Jersey and the surrounding area, positioning itself as a single-source supplier for both front-of-house and back-of-house needs.

The business was built on a commitment to courteous, knowledgeable service and access to recognized brand-name equipment. Leadership frames its differentiation around deep product knowledge, a vast selection of foodservice essentials, and a willingness to help customers solve specific operational challenges.
